pscomppars.csv.role: the original decimal radii, asymmetric uncertainties, masses, hosts and facilities of the confirmed planets — used to audit the Float32 embedding (item 2), system means (item 4) and the Scale Dynamics Observatory (items 26–30)

toi.csv.role: TESS Objects of Interest: an independent pipeline and selection — the replication sample of PREREGISTRATION_II (items 21–24), after excluding every TOI host that appears among the confirmed planets studied before

pscomppars-tic.csv.role: TIC identifiers of every confirmed host — the exclusion list for the replication sample

note: Downloaded before any phase statistic was computed on toi.csv. The preregistration II is committed together with these files.
